scope: Explicitly enabled optional slice timing on all voxels and all490 frames of a real BOLD. Default FNIT pipelines keep slice timing disabled. This is a kernel comparison with existing AFNI output, not a full pipeline equivalence test.
change: Correct float32 recursive phase multiplication and float32 weighted products before double trend accumulation, matching AFNI operation definitions.
limits: AFNI uses its own paired complex float32 FFT; PyTorch FFT ordering differs. No bitwise equivalence is claimed.
The original absolute-error threshold is retained even when it fails.
HMC, registration, surfaces, MSM and denoising are outside this kernel control.
